subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**satisfaction**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses the benefits of reading, including intellectual, emotional, and spiritual development.
 
• The appropriate word should reflect a positive mental state that comes with reading, as it improves one's mind and emotions.
 
• "**Satisfaction**" fits well in this context, as reading is known to bring fulfilment and contentment.
 
• Other options such as "**coverage**", "**success**", and "**exhaustion**" do not align with the concept of mental well-being or contentment derived from reading.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

Complete Passage: *The habit of reading is highly advantageous to us intellectually, emotionally and spiritually. As one gets into the habit of reading, one gets mental satisfaction__. It helps us acquire (2)________ and attain intellectual (3)_________. Reading takes away our (4)_________. Reading can bring (5)__________ in our sorrowful times and guide us in our duties.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• "**Coverage**" refers to the extent of something, but does not match the context of reading improving mental well-being.
 
• "**Success**" refers to achieving something, which does not fully capture the emotional and intellectual benefits of reading.
 
• "**Exhaustion**" contradicts the idea of reading being beneficial to the mind, as it implies fatigue rather than fulfilment.
